# streamtime_fleet (Data Source)

Reads a fleet, for example one created outside Terraform, to place workloads on it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "streamtime_fleet" "prod" {
  identifier = "prod"
}

output "fleet_status" {
  value = data.streamtime_fleet.prod.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) The fleet's identifier.

### Read-Only

- `autoscale` (Boolean) Whether node pools grow and shrink with load.
- `configuration_state` (String) Whether the fleet's settings are complete.
- `domain` (String) Base domain of the fleet's endpoints.
- `fleet_provider` (String) Where the fleet runs.
- `max_kafka_units` (Number) Cluster capacity the fleet can hold, in capacity units.
- `max_tenants` (Number) Most workloads that can share the fleet.
- `network` (String) Identifier of the fleet's network, if any.
- `placement_config` (String) Placement settings, as JSON.
- `reconciliation_state` (String) Progress of the last change.
- `status` (String) Health of the fleet, for example Healthy.
- `tenancy_mode` (String) Shared, Isolated or Dedicated.
- `workloads` (String) Workload categories the fleet hosts, as JSON.
